purpose: QA architecture for the eventual 2,210-image production run. Automated checks catch structural/mechanical defects; human sampling is the only thing that can validate semantic correctness, brand safety, and text leaks. This plan does not claim automated QA can replace human visual inspection.

layers.name: automated_static_checks
layers.description: Runs against every generated file and manifest entry after each batch collects. Fully automatable, zero human time, catches mechanical failures only.

checks.description: Manifest entry has status=succeeded but the output file does not exist on disk.
Two different canonical_interest_ids produced files with the same file_sha256 (suspicious duplication / stuck cache).
Image dimensions do not match the expected 2:3 aspect ratio within tolerance.
File size below a sane floor (e.g. <20KB) or fails to decode as a valid image.
Reuses the existing flatness/letterbox heuristic from generateCompiledBatch.js's analyzeGeneratedImage() as a best-effort signal for card-border/frame leakage; diagnostic only, not authoritative.
output_filename, prompt_sha256, or canonical_interest_id in the manifest do not match what the queue specified for that id.

If the provider ever exposes safety/classification metadata on a response, flag entries with elevated text/OCR-risk signals for priority human review; this is opportunistic, not a guaranteed detector.
Any entry with quarantined=true that somehow reached status=succeeded or submitted outside an explicitly-approved quarantine run - treated as a hard stop, not just a warning.

layers.name: representative_human_sampling
layers.description: A human opens and visually reviews a deterministic sample after each batch, using the same 15-dimension-style QA rubric used in the D4 calibration/durability/diversity rounds (semantic PASS/MINOR/FAIL, D4 fidelity, special-illustration feel, collectible appeal, brand/trademark leak, text leak, border/UI leak).

minimum_sample_per_batch.rationale: 10% of a ~120-image batch is ~12 images; the max(8, ...) floor keeps the last, smaller batch (~48 images) still meaningfully sampled.

layers.selection_rule: Stratified, not purely random: from each batch's sample quota, draw across as many distinct runtime_category values as the batch contains, plus at least one entry per distinct archetype present, before filling any remaining slots by stable-hash pseudo-random selection (same determinism pattern as the diversity layer, so the sample is reproducible).

layers.name: targeted_high_risk_review
layers.description: Independent of the per-batch percentage sample, every entry belonging to a declared high-risk family gets individual human review, not just a statistical chance of being sampled.

high_risk_families.match: runtime_category in [sports, fashion] or archetype in [solo_action, group_play] with footwear/apparel/equipment-heavy must_include
high_risk_families.reason: Proven leak source: fashion.streetwear's swoosh-like mark, sports.skateboarding's skate-shoe silhouette.

high_risk_families.match: runtime_category in [books, learning] or hobby recipes whose must_include mentions books, notes, diagrams, screens, or signage
high_risk_families.reason: Proven leak source: books.reading's invented book titles, wellness.tai_chi's background calligraphy.

high_risk_families.match: archetype = tech_workspace or must_include mentions monitor/laptop/device display
high_risk_families.reason: Historically screen/code-leak-prone family from earlier FLUX-era rounds.
Proven safety-sensitive family: earlier FLUX-era nudity-adjacent risk, and the cold_plunge warm-bath semantic drift.

high_risk_families.match: runtime_cluster shares a cluster with a quarantined interest, or recipe_source=derived with no manual review yet
high_risk_families.reason: Guards against a near-neighbor of american_football/robotics silently reproducing the same risk under a different canonical id.

layers.name: cluster_defect_escalation
layers.description: If layer 2 or layer 3 review finds the same defect type (semantic FAIL, brand leak, text leak, or border/UI leak) on 2 or more entries within one batch, or on the same runtime_category/archetype across two different batches, that is treated as a systemic cluster defect, not an isolated card issue.
layers.escalation_rule: Pause submission of any further not-yet-submitted batches immediately. Do not resume batch submission until: (a) the root cause is identified, (b) a recipe-level or global-policy fix is written and dry-run-validated, and (c) either a small targeted re-generation of the affected canonical ids confirms the fix, or the affected ids are pulled from auto-production pending manual review. This mirrors the localized-fix-not-global-rewrite pattern already used for books.reading/wellness.cold_plunge/sports.skateboarding/wellness.tai_chi.
